spec.name: mediatastelibrary-argument-desktop
spec.description: The argument, in chapters. Scene ranges are measured from the built page: a scene starts when its section enters at 85% of the viewport and ends when the next one does. Within a scene each effect is scrubbed (a proxy tween, scrub 0.6) from its OWN element's entry to where it is done, so it is never half-drawn while readable. Two signature moments (the load: grid, count and 131 modules; the ink flip into 'What broke') are time/state-based and checked in verify.sh, not here.

scenes.label: 01 — the walk visits the six steps (held stops)

expectations.note: --walk scrubs from the walk's own entry (top 85%) to its bottom at 75%, driving offset-distance through measured marker positions; 60% travel / 40% hold per leg; markers fill as reached.

scenes.label: 01 — the contact sheet, rows in award order
02 — the thesis is underlined as it is read (ink ground)

expectations.note: --find scrubs from the thesis's own entry (top 85%) to its bottom at mid-viewport, so the clause is underlined while it is read. The 1,118 and the spec figures count ONCE on enter (time-based), so they are not scroll-asserted.
Each [data-bars] block scrubs --bars from its own top at 90% to 55%; this asserts the first.

scenes.label: 04 — the ease atlas draws, row by row

expectations.note: --draw scrubs from the atlas's own entry (top 85%) to its bottom at 85%; each plot draws over a quarter of that, offset by its place (--f).

scenes.label: 05 — the exhibit dot rides the page's own ease
